name: GENPURE ULTIMA
summary: The Ultima RO Water Purifier is designed to provide pure, healthy, and mineral-enriched drinking water for homes using brackish water.
intro: ULTIMA is a premium domestic RO water purifier designed for brackish water, offering reliable purification with RO + UV technology and a 10-litre storage capacity. It features Sediment, Pre-Carbon, Post-Carbon, Alkaline and Copper filtration for improved water quality, taste, and mineral balance. With a 12 LPH purification capacity, 50W power consumption, and compact countertop design, it is suitable for everyday household use.
features: 5-stage filtration: Sediment, Pre-Carbon, Post-Carbon, Alkaline & Copper
Supports input TDS up to 3000 PPM
